primaryChecks.text: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
